column1: # Real truyenfullmoi.com pages, unedited, fetched directly — this host answers
# a plain request, so no Worker was needed. One row per captured page.
# capture_url is where the bytes came from; app_url is the URL the app uses.
# They are the same here: one host serves the catalogue, and the apex
# redirects to www rather than serving a second copy of it.
# columns: site  file  capture_url  app_url  kind  completed  chapters  max_page
# `chapters` is the DISTINCT chapter links inside #list-chapter and `max_page`
# the highest /<slug>.<id>/trang-N in the pagination — both measured at capture
# time with bs4/lxml, NOT with this app's parser, so the tests cross-check the
# two readings rather than echoing one back.
# The 100 were picked across finished AND ongoing and across listing sizes
# (1 page to 161, i.e. a handful of chapters up to ~8,000) rather than taken
# in crawl order, which is how a corpus of one shape gets built by accident.
